facts.statement: RackDefinitionCreator is `internal static class` in RackCad.Plugin.Systems.Shared with exactly two non-private members, both named CreateInTransaction; private helpers are UnusableEffectiveName, Precheck, Envelope. It has no fields or state.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Systems/Shared/RackDefinitionCreator.cs:36,39,83,121,137,201; guard tests/RackCad.Tests/RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:97-126 (exactly 2 entries, no loops, no static fields)

facts.statement: Overload A (header-run family) is CreateInTransaction(Database database, Transaction transaction, LateralHeaderDrawer drawer, HeaderRunPlan plan, string requestedBlockName, RackEmbedDocument envelope). Overload B (Cantilever family) is CreateInTransaction(Database database, Transaction transaction, CantileverViewPlan plan, string requestedBlockName, RackEmbedDocument envelope). No other plan type is accepted.
facts.evidence: RackDefinitionCreator.cs:39-45, 83-88; HeaderRunPlan defined at src/RackCad.Application/Drawing/HeaderRunPlan.cs:13; CantileverViewPlan at src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Cantilever/CantileverViewPlanBuilder.cs:123

facts.statement: Precheck refuses with TransactionMismatch when the database or transaction is null or disposed, or when database.TransactionManager.TopTransaction is null or its UnmanagedObject differs from transaction.UnmanagedObject. It never compares wrapper identity. An OpenCloseTransaction is unsupported on purpose. After that it checks InvalidPlan (plan is null, or the drawer is null in family A), InvalidBlockName (IsNullOrWhiteSpace), and InvalidEnvelope (envelope is null, or its Id, Kind or Name is blank). It then serializes with new RackEmbedStore().Serialize, and a throw there also gives InvalidEnvelope. Every refusal in Precheck happens before anything is written.
facts.evidence: RackDefinitionCreator.cs:145-194 (TopTransaction/UnmanagedObject at 156-164); guard RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:361-377 (asserts TopTransaction, UnmanagedObject, no ReferenceEquals), 347-359 (Precheck precedes write)

facts.statement: Family A calls drawer.CreateSystemBlock(database, transaction, plan, requestedBlockName). It then checks UnusableEffectiveName(created.BlockName), which returns WriteFailed if the name is blank. Next, if created.Outcome.HasMissingBlocks, it returns Missing(MissingInstances) and does NOT write the envelope. Otherwise it calls Envelope(...). Any exception becomes WriteFailed. It never erases anything to clean up.
facts.evidence: RackDefinitionCreator.cs:53-79, 121-131; guards RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:379-392 (catch + no Erase), 394-403 (missing before envelope), 405-435 (name check before envelope)

facts.statement: Family B calls CantileverViewMaterializer.CreateBlockDefinitionNamed(database, transaction, plan, requestedBlockName, out blockName), then UnusableEffectiveName(blockName), then Envelope. Any exception becomes WriteFailed. This family has no missing-block check.

Envelope() calls RackBlockData.Write(transaction, definitionId, payloadJson), then reads the value back with RackBlockData.Read and compares it to payloadJson with ordinal equality. A mismatch gives EnvelopeWriteFailed; a match gives Created(definitionId, blockName). This readback matters because RackBlockData.Write returns silently when the id is null or the JSON is empty.

AUTH-15 does not derive, sanitize or uniquify names; it passes requestedBlockName straight to the family. Header-run family: LateralHeaderDrawer.NewBlock -> UniqueBlockName, which applies BlockNaming.SanitizeBlockName and then adds a _1, _2, ... suffix on collision. Cantilever family: UniqueBlockName(blockTable, Sanitize(baseName)). The name the family actually produced is returned in the result.

RackDefinitionCreator does not open a transaction, lock the document, commit, abort, dispose, regenerate, purge, import (no EnsureForPlan, BlockLibraryImporter or EnsureBlocks), place references (no BlockReference, ModelSpace, AppendEntity or InsertReference), compose or restamp the envelope (no RackEmbedComposer or RackEnvelopeRestamp), transform, or show any UI.

The guard test lists, by exact signature, the members AUTH-15 reaches to write: LateralHeaderDrawer (CreateSystemBlock, NewBlock, AppendInstance, AppendDimension, ResolveDimStyle, EnsureAnnotationLayer, ApplyDynamicParameters, UniqueBlockName), CantileverViewMaterializer (CreateBlockDefinitionNamed, AppendCurves, EnsureRoleLayers, UniqueBlockName, Sanitize), LayerHelper.EnsureLayer, and RackBlockData.Write/Read. It forbids Commit(, Abort(, StartTransaction, LockDocument, Regen, Purge(, EnsureForPlan, ModelSpace, Editor and similar tokens in those bodies.

facts.topic: Side effects inside the caller transaction (header-run drawer)
facts.statement: CreateSystemBlock opens the BlockTable ForWrite. It creates one nested BTR per plan.Headers group, and those carry no envelope. It then creates the system BTR. Layers RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES (ACI 2) and RACKCAD_COTAS (ACI 1) are created through LayerHelper.EnsureLayer if they are missing. Dimensions are RotatedDimension with RecomputeDimensionBlock; the code comment says each owns an anonymous *D block. Pieces whose BlockName is blank or absent from the BlockTable are skipped and recorded once per BlockName|View.

RackDefinitionCreationResult is `internal readonly struct` with IsSuccess, DefinitionId (ObjectId.Null on failure), BlockName (null on failure, never empty on success), Failure, MissingInstances (IReadOnlyList<HeaderBlockInstance>, empty unless MissingLibraryBlocks) and Diagnostic. Its internal factories are Created, Failed and Missing. Failure enum: None, TransactionMismatch, InvalidPlan, InvalidBlockName, MissingLibraryBlocks, InvalidEnvelope, EnvelopeWriteFailed, WriteFailed. Success does not mean committed.

At this commit there is NO production caller of RackDefinitionCreator in src/. Across the extract, the only occurrences are its own two files and the source-text guard test. A guard asserts that no src/RackCad.Application file mentions it.
facts.evidence: Grep 'RackDefinitionCreat' over the extract: matches only in src/RackCad.Plugin/Systems/Shared/RackDefinitionCreator.cs, RackDefinitionCreationResult.cs and tests/RackCad.Tests/RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs; guard :477-488

facts.statement: SystemBlockWriter.RedefineInTransaction(Database, Transaction, LateralHeaderDrawer, ObjectId blockId, HeaderRunPlan, string payloadJson, out IReadOnlyCollection<ObjectId> staleDefinitions) calls drawer.RedefineSystemBlock and then RackBlockData.Write. It does not check TopTransaction, read back, or check missing blocks. It is reached through ViewBlockDraw.RedrawInTransaction, the Selective facades' RedrawInTransaction and LateralHeaderDrawService.

SelectiveFrontalBuilder.BuildPlan(SelectiveRackSystem, RackCatalog) returns HeaderRunPlan (HeaderInstanceGrouper.Group(Build(...), "SEL_FRONTAL")). SelectivePlantaBuilder.BuildPlan(SelectiveRackSystem, RackCatalog) also returns HeaderRunPlan. Both match the plan parameter type of RackDefinitionCreator overload A.

Both the Selective frontal/planta creation path and AUTH-15 family A run the same drawer method, LateralHeaderDrawer.CreateSystemBlock(Database, Transaction, HeaderRunPlan, string). The Selective path gets there via DrawAndPlace -> ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace -> SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock -> drawer.CreateSystemBlock; AUTH-15 calls drawer.CreateSystemBlock directly. Each Selective facade holds its own `new LateralHeaderDrawer()`.
facts.evidence: SelectiveFrontalDrawService.cs:24,31-39; SelectivePlantaDrawService.cs:24,26-34; ViewBlockDraw.cs:50; SystemBlockWriter.cs:18-29; RackDefinitionCreator.cs:55; LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:28-81

facts.statement: InsertSelectiveFrontal computes blockName = RackViewBaseName.LinkedSelectiveFrontal(name or "Selectivo", fondo, fondoCount) and passes it as rackName. The facade then applies RackViewBaseName.SelectiveFrontal(system, rackName), which is Standard(rackName.Trim()) = BlockNaming.SanitizeBlockName. The drawer sanitizes again and uniquifies. The frontal geometry comes from SelectiveDepthLayout.FondoSystemView(system, fondo).

Planta calls DrawAndPlace(document, system, plantaPayload, name). The facade uses RackViewBaseName.SelectivePlanta(system, name), which gives Standard(name.Trim() + " - planta"), or "Selectivo planta - {n} frentes" when the name is blank. The drawer then sanitizes and uniquifies. AUTH-15 applies no view base-name policy, so a caller must supply the RackViewBaseName-derived name itself to match.

The Selective path composes the envelope in WrapSelectivePayload with RackEmbedComposer.Compose(source, KindSelective, id, name, view (ViewFrontal when blank), section, designJson) and serializes it with new RackEmbedStore().Serialize. Frontal uses view=frontal and section=fondo; planta uses view=planta and section=-1 (the default). View strings are literal constants, not RackViewCodec.Encode. AUTH-15 receives a RackEmbedDocument, never composes, and serializes with the same RackEmbedStore.Serialize.

If a caller passes AUTH-15 the same RackEmbedDocument that RackEmbedComposer.Compose produces, the payload bytes should equal the Selective path's, because both use RackEmbedStore.Serialize with the same static options (compact, case-insensitive). This was not run.

The Selective path imports library blocks with BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan(database, plan) inside the document lock but BEFORE and OUTSIDE its own transaction. EnsureBlocks opens its own transactions, WblockClones into the drawing, is best-effort, and returns 0 when the library file is absent. AUTH-15 never imports, so the caller must prepare (import) before opening its transaction, following the PrepareRedraw pattern.
facts.evidence: SystemBlockWriter.cs:23-27; BlockLibraryImporter.cs:18, 25-39, 50-132 (own tx 68-80, WblockCloneObjects 123, file absent 87-91); ViewBlockDraw.cs:59-89 (PrepareRedraw imports outside tx)

facts.statement: SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock takes LockDocument, opens StartTransaction, writes the payload only if it is non-empty (no readback), and commits. AUTH-15 uses the caller's verified top transaction and never commits.

In the Selective path, pieces missing from the library are omitted from the geometry, the envelope is still written, and the missing pieces are only reported as text (DescribeMissing). AUTH-15 returns MissingLibraryBlocks and writes no envelope; the definition remains in the caller's transaction for rollback.

The Selective path places the block with BlockPlacement.PlaceAndReport -> PlaceBlockWithJig. That uses its own lock and StartTransaction, editor.Drag, a model-space AppendEntity and a Commit. If the user cancels, EraseUnreferencedDefinition runs in yet another own transaction plus PurgeUnreferenced. So today's Selective create is at least two commits (definition, then reference) plus the import mutation. AUTH-15 places nothing.
The Selective path builds the plan inside ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace from RackCatalogLoader.Load(), and exceptions become HeaderPlacementResult.Failure. AUTH-15 receives a plan that is already built.

The Selective LATERAL cut is created through LateralHeaderDrawService.DrawAndPlace -> private CreateBlock, which groups the layout into a HeaderRunPlan internally (HeaderInstanceGrouper.Group(layout.Instances, blockName)) and then calls drawer.CreateSystemBlock. That plan is not exposed by a public BuildPlan.

`public static string Read(Transaction transaction, ObjectId entityId)` uses the caller's transaction. It opens the entity ForRead, then its extension dictionary, then the Xrecord under key "RACKCAD_SELECTIVE" (the key used for every kind), and concatenates the DxfCode.Text chunks. It returns null if there is no transaction, a null id, no ext dict, no key, no data or an empty result. It is read-only. Write is a separate member that returns silently on a null id or empty JSON.

`public static List<RackEnvelopeScan> ScanEnvelopes(Transaction transaction, Database database, bool includeReferenceCount)` uses the caller's transaction and makes one pass over the BlockTable in traversal order. It SKIPS IsLayout (model/paper space), IsAnonymous (e.g. *D/*U), IsFromExternalReference, and every definition whose RackBlockData.Read is null or empty (library blocks and nested SEL_FRONTAL group defs, which have no envelope). Each scan entry holds (DefinitionId, Embed, DirectReferenceCount, BlockName); Embed is null when the envelope does not deserialize. DirectReferenceCount = GetBlockReferenceIds(directOnly:true, forceValidity:false).Count, only when requested, and is measured independently of the payload. It is read-only.
Deserialize returns null for blank input, a JsonException, a null result, or an unreadable MAJOR schema version; it never throws. Serialize throws on null.

`public static BlockReference FindFirstModelSpaceReference(Transaction, Database, List<(ObjectId BlockId, RackEmbedDocument Embed)>)` uses the caller's transaction. It returns the first live BlockReference owned by model space, frontal first. It is read-only but returns a DBObject.

`public static List<(ObjectId BlockId, RackEmbedDocument Embed)> FindRackBlocks(Document document, string rackId)` opens its OWN LockDocument and StartTransaction and commits. It calls ScanEnvelopes(includeReferenceCount:false) and keeps entries whose Embed.Id equals rackId (OrdinalIgnoreCase), accepting a missing Kind. It writes nothing. It is not caller-owned.

Whether readers that open their own StartTransaction (FindRackBlocks, AutoCadLibraryBlockQuery, ReadDimensionStyleNames, InDocumentTransaction.Run) nest correctly under an open caller transaction, and leave TopTransaction as the caller's afterwards, is AutoCAD runtime behaviour that the code does not show. Calling ScanEnvelopes directly with the caller's transaction avoids the question.

DecodeView(RackEmbedDocument) is pure: RackViewCodec.Decode(embed?.Kind, embed?.View, embed?.Section ?? -1). IsPlantaView returns true when the decoded address is Planta. Neither opens a transaction or writes.

RackViewCodec is a pure static codec: TryDecodeViewKind, DecodeKind, Decode(kind, view, section) -> DecodedRackView{OriginalSyntax, SystemKind, Address, HasAddress, Disposition, CoercionCode}, and Encode(RackSystemKind, RackViewAddress). Decoding for kind "selective" (RackSystemKind.SelectiveRack): lateral needs section >= 0 and gives Post(section), otherwise Invalid. Planta gives Whole, and is Coerced when section != -1. Frontal gives Fondo(section), with section < 0 coerced to Fondo(0). Any other view is coerced to frontal. Encode for Selective: Fondo(i) -> ("frontal", i), Post(i) -> ("lateral", i), planta -> ("planta", -1).

`RackViewAvailability.Evaluate(DecodedRackView, RackViewAvailabilityFacts)` is pure. It returns Unavailable when there is no address or no facts, SystemDoesNotSupportKind on a kind mismatch, and otherwise Available or VariantNotPresent. SelectiveViewAvailabilityFacts(int fondoCount, IEnumerable<int> postIndexes) accepts planta Whole, Fondo index < FondoCount, and Post in the given set. It never selects a fallback.

`public static AuthoredAuthorityResult Resolve(string rackId, IReadOnlyList<ProjectVariableScanEntry> siblings)` is pure. It returns UnreadableSibling if there are no siblings or any sibling is null, has !AuthoredReadable, or has a null Authored; it never filters those out. Otherwise it returns Single(documents[0]) when IsSameAuthority, else Divergent. IsSameAuthority(IReadOnlyList<SelectivePalletDesignDocument>) is public. It compares structurally over the JSON serialized with WhenWritingNull: objects ignore member order, arrays keep order, numbers compare as doubles, and SchemaVersion and ExtensionData are included. View and section are not in this document.

ProjectVariableScanProjection.Project(string definitionId, RackEmbedDocument embed, int directReferenceCount) is pure. A null embed or a blank Id/Kind gives UnreadableEnvelope; a non-selective kind gives Foreign; a design whose SelectivePalletDesignStore.Deserialize throws InvalidOperationException gives SelectiveUnreadableDesign; otherwise Selective(authored). This is the input type that Resolve requires. Production callers build it from ScanEnvelopes + Handle.ToString().

IRackAuthoredComparatorPort<in TInput, TAuthored> has Kind and Compare(TInput) -> RackAuthoredComparisonResult<TAuthored>{Outcome Single|Divergent|Unreadable, Authored, Diagnostic}. RackAuthoredComparatorPorts.Selective() returns the private SelectiveComparator for SelectiveAuthoredComparisonInput(rackId, siblings). It returns Unreadable for null input and otherwise maps SelectiveAuthoredAuthority.Resolve 1:1. There is no production caller in src; it is used only in tests (SharedViewFoundationF6Tests.cs:178). Dynamic/PushBack/Cantilever/Cabecera have non-generic typed comparators (AUTH-13 raw reader); Cama and the generic overloads are unsupported and return Unreadable.

IRackResolvePort<in TInput, TResolved> has Kind and Resolve(TInput) -> RackResolveResult<TResolved>. RackResolveAdapter calls the supplied delegate once and maps null input to UnreadableInput, a null result to ResolutionFailure, a blocked diagnostic to Blocked, and an exception to ResolutionFailure. RackResolvePorts.Selective<TInput,TResolved>(Func resolver, Func blocked) is only a generic factory; src contains no concrete Selective resolver adapter instance, only tests.

IRackViewPreparationPort<in TResolved, TPayload>.Prepare(resolved, RackViewAddress, RackViewFrameResult, string baseName) returns RackPreparedView<TPayload>{Kind, Address, Frame, BaseName, BlockRequirements, Payload}. The adapter calls the builder once and extracts requirements from the typed payload; it does not materialize, import or open transactions. PrepareV2 adds PieceRequirements. RackViewPreparationPorts.Selective(builder, supports, requirements) exists, but src contains no Selective instance, only tests. RackBlockRequirementExtractors.HeaderRun extracts distinct non-blank BlockNames from LooseInstances and Headers[].Instances.

`internal sealed class AutoCadLibraryBlockQuery : ILibraryBlockQuery`, constructed with a Database. Query(IReadOnlyList<LibraryBlockRequirement>) opens its OWN StartTransaction (no lock), checks BlockTable.Has(key) -> Found/Missing, and commits. It writes nothing. Its only production user is BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan through LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow.Observe(allowImport:true), which queries AFTER the import.

AutoCadExternalLibraryBlockQuery reads the external library DWG (BlockLibraryDatabaseCache side database), not the active drawing. It uses its own transaction on the source database and returns FileMissing/Unknown/Present/Missing observations.

ProjectVariablesData.Read(Transaction, Database) uses the caller's transaction. It reads the NOD entry "RACKCAD_PROJECT" as an Xrecord of text chunks and returns ProjectVariablesPayload Absent, Present(json) or Unreadable. It never throws (catches System.Exception). ProjectVariablesRegistry.Read(Transaction, Database) = new ProjectVariablesStore().Read(ProjectVariablesData.Read(...)) -> ProjectVariablesReadResult; the caller owns the transaction. Writes exist separately (Data.Write, and Registry.TryWrite guarded by lastRead).

CustomPropertiesData.Read(Transaction, Database) uses the caller's transaction. It reads the NOD entry "RACKCAD_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES" and returns CustomPropertiesPayload Absent, Present or Unreadable. It catches only Autodesk.AutoCAD.Runtime.Exception and disposes the ResultBuffer. It is interpreted by new CustomPropertiesStore().Read(...). A Write member exists separately.

Other read accessors: CustomPropertiesExecutor.SelectionOf(Transaction, ObjectId) is caller-owned and returns handle + IsFromExternalReference. CustomPropertiesExecutor.ScanProjection (private) is caller-owned and adds IsDependent and placed. RackCommandSupport.ReadDimensionStyleNames(Document) opens its own tx and reads DimStyleTable names. RackCommandSupport.PickRackBlock prompts, then reads through InDocumentTransaction. RackDuplicarCommands.TakeSnapshot (private) opens its own tx and reads selected references, ownerId == model space, position/rotation/scale/layer, and definition payload + name. LateralHeaderDrawService.ReadBlockName (private) uses StartOpenCloseTransaction. RackUnitsGuard reads Database.Insunits.

Only ScanEnvelopes enumerates the drawing's BlockTable, and it filters (see F2.02). Grep of RackCad.Plugin finds no reader that enumerates all block-table names, all layers, the whole NOD or all model-space content. LayerHelper.EnsureLayer only does Has() and creates the layer when it is missing (a writer). The only other model-space enumeration is RACKRELLENAR's layer-outline scan.
facts.evidence: Grep BlockTableId/LayerTableId/NamedObjectsDictionaryId in src/RackCad.Plugin (enumeration only at RackBlockFinder.cs:62-63); RackLayoutCommands.Fill.cs:159-190; LayerHelper.cs:16-29

facts.statement: ProjectVariableMutationExecutor prepares all views first (PrepareRedraw, which imports outside the tx). It then opens ONE StartTransaction and, inside it, re-reads ProjectVariablesRegistry.Read and ScanEnvelopes -> Project and calls RegistryCommit.Prepare(plan, lastRead, currentEntries). On IsBlocked, or when TryWrite fails, it returns Aborted without Commit, so dispose rolls back. Only after that does it write the views, commit once, then PurgeAfterCommit and ApplyRegen.

RackBlockRenamer.SyncName opens its own lock and tx and RENAMES the BTR (commit). RackCommandSupport.EraseViewBlocks erases definitions and references in its own tx plus a purge. Neither is read-only.

The source guards locate the repo root by walking up from AppContext.BaseDirectory until RackCad.sln exists, read files with File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "src", "RackCad.Plugin", ...)), and assert on text. Their stated reason: no suite can load the Plugin (ADR-0003) and CI has no AutoCAD.

RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.Code() cuts each line at its first "//"; it does not handle block comments or string literals. CantileverPluginSourceGuardTests.CodeOnly() removes /* */ blocks (Singleline regex) and then // comments. CallerOwnedTransactionGuardTests and CallerOwnedFacadeGuardTests assert on raw text, comments included.

Four body locators exist. (1) Body(source, signature, occurrence) matches braces from the n-th signature (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:57-90). (2) MemberBody(code, signature, file) requires the signature to end in '(' and be unique, skips the parameter list, and handles expression bodies (=> ... ;); it has a self-test (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:256-311, 335-343). (3) CallerOwnedFacadeGuardTests.Body handles expression bodies without a uniqueness check (:58-92). (4) SelectiveTransactionBoundaryGuardTests.BodyOf is line-based and ends at member-level indentation (tests/RackCad.UI.Tests/SelectiveTransactionBoundaryGuardTests.cs:64-80).

The assertion styles in use are: (a) forbidden tokens in a body or file with Assert.DoesNotContain, e.g. "Commit(", "Abort(", "StartTransaction", "StartOpenCloseTransaction", "LockDocument", "Regen", "EnsureForPlan", "BlockReference", "ModelSpace", "Erase(" (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:130-196, 391; CallerOwnedFacadeGuardTests.cs:112-161; CallerOwnedTransactionGuardTests.cs:91-126). (b) Required tokens with Assert.Contains, e.g. TopTransaction and UnmanagedObject (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:361-377). (c) Ordering via IndexOf comparisons: Precheck < write, missing-check < Envelope, Write < Read, prepare < StartTransaction, Commit < Purge < Regen (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:347-359, 394-403, 447-456; CallerOwnedTransactionGuardTests.cs:179-231; ProjectVariableMutationExecutorTests.cs:255-278). (d) Exact counts: Count(source, "Commit()") == 1, StartTransaction() == 1, ApplyRegen == 1 (ProjectVariableMutationExecutorTests.cs:186-198, 225-244), Regex.Matches(...).Count == 2 (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:99-100), a single Editor.Regen() (CantileverPluginSourceGuardTests.cs:171). (e) A table of delegated members x forbidden tokens (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:216-254, 313-333). (f) Theory/MemberData over several files (CallerOwnedFacadeGuardTests.cs:49-56, 96-191). (g) Directory-wide scans with exclusions: Directory.EnumerateFiles(Application) with DoesNotContain (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:477-488), and Directory.GetFiles(Plugin) excluding obj/bin with a Regex word match (CantileverPluginSourceGuardTests.cs:95-108). (h) Regex negative matches for static state or assignment (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:121-125, 183).

Token guards are substring-based, so any identifier containing a forbidden word trips them: 'Editor' is forbidden in the whole creator (RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:190-196) and 'Regen' in the delegated bodies (:250). A P-5 guard modelled on them inherits that coarseness unless it uses word-boundary Regex, as CantileverPluginSourceGuardTests.cs:103 does.
